summary: IPG Photonics filed an 8-K disclosing execution of a share purchase agreement to acquire 100% of Lumibird Medical, a wholly-owned French subsidiary of Euronext-listed Lumibird S.A., for €300M cash-free, debt-free, payable in cash at closing, plus up to €50M contingent earn-out tied to 2026-2027 performance metrics. The seller exercised its put option following French works council consultation. Funding comes from cash on hand; warranty and indemnity insurance covers rep breaches, with seller liability capped at €1 except fraud. Closing awaits French FDI ministerial authorization. Watch regulatory clearance timing and earn-out achievement risk.
